# OWASP API Security Checklist: [FEATURE NAME]

**Feature**: [Link to spec.md]
**Created**: [DATE]
**Standard**: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) + OWASP ASVS V13
**When required**: Every feature that exposes or consumes APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, internal service endpoints). Generated by `__SPECKIT_COMMAND_PLAN__`; completed during Security Verification & Hardening and checked by the Converge gate.

## API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)

- [ ] Every endpoint that accesses an object verifies the caller owns/can-access THAT object (not just "is authenticated")
- [ ] Object identifiers are not sequential/enumerable where feasible (UUIDs or indirect references)
- [ ] IDOR tests exist: user A accessing user B's resource returns 403/404 (negative tests per endpoint)
- [ ] Response filtering verified: no object leakage via related/endpoints (e.g., nested includes)

## API2:2023 Broken Authentication

- [ ] All non-public endpoints require authentication (inventory: [count] endpoints, [count] explicitly public)
- [ ] Public endpoints are allow-listed and reviewed
- [ ] Tokens: strong random generation, correct validation (signature, audience, issuer, expiry)
- [ ] No auth secrets in URLs or query strings
- [ ] Auth endpoints rate-limited and account-enumeration-safe

## API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization

- [ ] Response schemas explicitly allow-list properties (no model dumping)
- [ ] Mass assignment prevented: write paths bind only to expected fields (never client-controlled role/price/flags)
- [ ] Sensitive properties (cost, role, internal flags) filtered per caller authorization
- [ ] Property-level tests: privileged fields absent for unprivileged callers

## API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption

- [ ] Rate limits per endpoint class (documented: [table or reference])
- [ ] Request size caps (body, files, arrays) enforced
- [ ] Query complexity limits (GraphQL depth/amount; pagination max page size)
- [ ] Timeouts + bounded concurrency on processing; execution time capped

## API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization

- [ ] Admin/management routes separated, gated by role checks at the route AND handler layer
- [ ] HTTP method + path combos tested against role matrix (deny-by-default verified)
- [ ] Privilege checks cannot be bypassed by method override, headers, or parameter tampering

## API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows

- [ ] Business-critical flows enumerated: [flows list]
- [ ] Each flow has anti-automation (rate limits, challenges, progressive delays)
- [ ] Flow abuse tests documented (e.g., bulk signup, rapid checkout, OTP flooding)

## API7:2023 Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

- [ ] Any endpoint accepting URLs/hostnames validated: scheme restricted to http/https
- [ ] Host validation rejects localhost, loopback (127.0.0.0/8, ::1), private (RFC1918), link-local, and reserved ranges unless explicitly required — and then allow-listed
- [ ] Redirect handling does not re-enable blocked targets
- [ ] Outbound requests use dedicated egress with DNS resolution validated (no DNS rebinding)

## API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration

- [ ] TLS 1.2+ enforced everywhere; HSTS where applicable
- [ ] CORS: explicit origin allow-list; no wildcard with credentials
- [ ] Security headers on all responses (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame options)
- [ ] Error responses: generic message + correlation ID; no stack traces/versions
- [ ] Debug/admin endpoints disabled or gated in production; OpenAPI/docs exposure decided explicitly

## API9:2023 Improper Inventory Management

- [ ] API inventory current: hosts, versions, lifecycle (spec, retirement dates)
- [ ] Deprecated/old versions disabled or tightly gated (no shadow endpoints)
- [ ] API documentation matches implemented authZ reality (drift-checked)

## API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs

- [ ] Third-party API responses validated as untrusted input (schema, types, sizes)
- [ ] Third-party endpoints called with least-privilege credentials
- [ ] Retries/timeouts/circuit breakers configured; failures fail securely
- [ ] Callbacks/webhooks (if any): signature verification + replay protection
